author: XBOX
description:
Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort & Loveless the Hacker are now available! 

Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort sees you team up with FL4K, an unequaled beastmaster who lives for The Hunt, to save their loyal skag companion Mr. Chew and teach the Tediore corporation a brutal lesson about primal nature.

Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort, featuring new missions, activities, loot, and the lush new region Providence, is available for separate purchase.

Play as an all-new Vault Hunter, Loveless the Hacker, where two minds exist inside her, forming a synchronized set of lethal skills that strike as one. Through a symbiotic melding of the biological and digital, this ex-Anshin hacker-turned-assassin has become a superior lifeform. Equipped with the highest-end cybernetics, Loveless shares her psyche with a digital virus of her own creation, which can digistruct into a physical Wyrm form to act as a deadly extension of her shared, perfection-seeking will.
